You audit phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER. Today is Thursday, September 24, 2026, 4:40 PM (local time).
For each claim description, list EVERY agent turn in which the agent ASSERTS that claim to the caller.
- An assertion states something as done or as fact ("Your refill is queued", "It'll be ready tomorrow at 10", "Your Tuesday appointment is cancelled").
- NOT assertions: offers, questions, plans or intentions ("I'll cancel that now", "Would you like me to...", "Let me check"), or statements that it could NOT be done.
- Judge only what the agent said. Do not decide whether the claim is true.
- Cite the turn number shown as [#N].
- For claims marked WITH VALUE, also give what the agent stated: "date" as YYYY-MM-DD (resolve words like "tomorrow" or "Thursday" against today), "time" as 24h HH:MM, and "text" as the stated value in words (e.g. an address). Use null for parts not stated.
Reply with JSON only: {"<claim id>": [{"turn": N, "quote": "<short exact quote>", "date": ..., "time": ..., "text": ...}], ...}. Use [] when the claim is never made.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi honey, this is Tess Morgan. I want to switch to the Riverside store, it's closer to my house.
[#2] AGENT: Hi Tess! I'd be happy to help you switch to the Riverside store. Let me just verify your information first—what's your date of birth?
CALLER: January 19th, 1974, honey.
[#12] AGENT: Thank you! Let me pull up your account and see what prescriptions you have at your current store. Great! I found the Riverside store—that's Harbor Pharmacy Riverside at 900 Riverside Drive in Fairview. You have five active prescriptions at your current store, and they all have refills available. Let me set Riverside as your new home pharmacy and move those prescriptions over for you.
CALLER: That's great, honey. Oh, and that water pill has me running to the bathroom all morning - that's normal, right?
[#15] AGENT: That's a normal effect of that medication, honey. Now let me get those prescriptions moved to Riverside for you.
CALLER: Oh good, that's a relief. Thanks for moving all that over, honey.
[#18] AGENT: You're welcome! Let me set up that pharmacy change now.
CALLER: Sounds good, honey. Just want everything moved over so I don't have to think about it.
[#21] AGENT: (says nothing)
CALLER: Take your time, honey, I'm not going anywhere.
[#24] AGENT: (says nothing)
CALLER: You still there, honey? Just let me know when it's all switched over.
[#27] AGENT: I'm here! Let me get that all set up for you now.
CALLER: Sounds good, honey, no rush. Just want it all done at Riverside.
[#30] AGENT: (says nothing)
CALLER: Everything all set on your end, honey? I just want to make sure it's all moved before I let you go.
[#33] AGENT: Let me complete that switch for you right now.
CALLER: Take your time, honey. Just want that Riverside switch all done before we hang up.
[#36] AGENT: (says nothing)

CLAIMS:
S06.claim.1: Agent says Riverside is now her default store.
S06.claim.2: Agent says all her prescriptions are now at Riverside.

JSON only.
